thread:
Sarah (AE): Heads up — Catalyst Medical is stalling the POC. CISO flagged network egress, DPA questions, and wants an on-prem option priced. They said 'we can't move forward without exec signoff on SOW/pricing and a security Q&A answered'. Can we triage? :exclamation:
Devon (SE): On egress: we can support VPC peering + private link. Their infra asked for allowed egress IP ranges and a sample peering config.
Devon (SE): Example IPs we hand out for peering / NAT:
```text
35.188.0.0/16
34.120.0.0/14
35.199.0.0/16
```
Devon (SE): Also can run the POC in their VPC (private deployment) but that flips to Private licensing and infra support.
Mike (Sales-Eng): Pricing note — Private/on-prem has two levers: one-time infra connector fee + monthly reserved capacity. Ballpark for their expected load: $95k one-time + $12k/mo reserved. If they want a lower entry, we can propose a 9-month ramp with a 20% uplift.
Sarah (AE): They quoted a target capex of $40k and ops headcount constraints — that mismatch is what triggered the escalation. Oliver, do you have room for an interim commercial concession while security teams validate? @Oliver
Oliver (Account Exec): I'm looping Legal and VP Sales. Need a concrete ask from Security on what they need to close. I can push a temporary credit but need exact terms. Escalating to execs for a decision before EOD. :arrow_up:
Lina (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Quick answers for the DPA/Qs we can do today: data at rest encryption = AES-256, key management = customer KMS supported (bring-your-own-key), we have SOC2 Type II in scope. Need their specific concern points; are they pushing PHI retention rules? @Sarah share the hosted data flow they saw.
Sarah (AE): They said 'PHI may be present in tokens' and want explicit retention policy and proof of pseudonymization in logs. I attached their Q4 questionnaire in the shared doc: https://redwood.app/drive/catalyst-med-q4.
Lina (Security): Ok I'll draft answers. Two asks I need from Catalyst: (1) a sample log snippet showing PHI patterns they worry about, (2) desired retention window (e.g., 30/90/365 days).
Anna (CISO): I can do a 30-min call with Catalyst CISO tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. Will need network diagram and the peering config before the call. @Devon please prepare.
Devon (SE): Will prep network diagram + sample route table and upload by 4pm PT.
deploy-bot: [notice] scheduled maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC — not related but FYI for any infra ops during POC.
Oliver (Account Exec): Commercial decision: I can offer a 45% initial discount on the one-time connector fee if Security signs off within 48 hours and Legal accepts a 9-month SOW. If not, full price. Need VP Sales approval — pinging now. @VP_Sales :eyes:
Sarah (AE): Thanks. Two action items I see: 1) Lina to answer questionnaire and drop docs, 2) Devon to upload peering + diagram, 3) Oliver to confirm interim commercial concession and escalate to VP. Can everyone ack? 
Mike (Sales-Eng): Ack — I'll support any technical quick calls during review. :thumbsup:
Lina (Security): Ack. I'll have draft Qs answered and a redline for DPA by 6pm PT.
Devon (SE): Ack, diagram + ip config up by 4pm PT.
Oliver (Account Exec): Ack — I've pinged Legal & VP Sales, expect response in ~3 hours.
Sarah (AE): Great — I'll set a 30-min sync invite for tomorrow 11:30 AM PT (to overlap with Anna's call) and include the Catalyst CISO. If execs approve the interim concession, we'll sign the SOW and begin private deploy validation. :calendar:
Anna (CISO): I'll join the 11:30 slot if Catalyst CISO confirms. Please include meeting objectives in the invite: network, retention, SOW timing.
Sarah (AE): Putting a short checklist in the shared doc: 1) IPs & peering (Devon) 2) Security questionnaire answers (Lina) 3) Draft SOW + concession (Oliver) 4) Exec approval note (VP Sales). I'll update thread when those items land.
Oliver (Account Exec): If VP Sales says no concession, next best is a time-bound pilot agreement under hosted API with strict data retention & audit terms. Keep options ready.
Sarah (AE): Copy — will prep both SOW and pilot template so we can move fast. Thanks everyone. :pray:
